title: Merchandise Purchases — Refund Settlement Schedule (Timing, Destination and Tender Order)
content:
Finance and Customer Care settle refunds of **Merchandise Purchases** on the terms below. The first column varies by merchandise class; every other term is the same for all seven classes.

## Refund timing

| Merchandise class | Refund issued within (business days after the returned item is received) |
|---|---|
| Apparel, Shoes & Accessories | 5 |
| Beauty & Fragrance | 5 |
| Home & Kitchen | 5 |
| Electronics & Small Appliances | 5 |
| Fine Jewelry & Watches | 7 |
| Designer Handbags & Luxury | 7 |
| Furniture & Mattresses | 10 |

## Terms common to every class

| Term | Setting (all seven classes) |
|---|---|
| Refund destination of a gift-receipt return | a merchandise credit card |
| Order in which a refund is spread over the tenders of a mixed-tender purchase | Marlowe & Finch card first, then bank card, then debit, then cash, then gift card |
| Refund on a cash purchase mailed as a check instead of paid in cash | when the refund is above $500.00 |
| Sales tax refunded | in proportion to the merchandise amount refunded |
| Destination of a registry gift (bought by a guest from a gift registry) returned by the registrant | registrant credit on the registry |
| Finch Circle points and qualifying spend reduced for a return | Yes |
| Spreading of an order-level promotion or coupon over the units of the order | pro rata by each unit's price before the discount |

### Points of reading

- A refund of exactly $500.00 on a cash purchase is not above the threshold; a refund of $500.01 is.
- Hypothetical mixed-tender refund: a unit paid partly on a Marlowe & Finch card and partly in cash is refunded to the Marlowe & Finch card portion first, and only then to cash.
- Hypothetical coupon spread: a $20.00 order coupon on two units priced $60.00 and $40.00 before the discount is spread $12.00 and $8.00.
